text: init_scripts on ClusterSpec and presets, with UI form fields and a documented API (user-approved scope, 2026-10-24).
Releases, pin bumps and the helmfile apply plus smoke are tasks of this epic (user-approved scope, 2026-10-24).
Init scripts are new: ClusterSpec + preset field; run once per cluster (not per pod, not per restart).
Exposed to the agent initialised with them, so it knows how it was initialised.
An agent edit writes to the cluster's stored spec AND to its source preset when there is one.

One shared orchestrator any-mcp plugin carries every agent-to-orchestrator tool, with a per-cluster scoped credential in the pod; built once by hive-mode-leadership-handove, the other epics add tools to it.
Headless parity: every UI capability has a documented public API and an API-only e2e test.
